text:
maria (PM): quick UX review thread — poking at the compact compare layout we demoed. main concerns: filter shelf persistence, row density, performance badges, and the version-pin affordance. attaching figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/compare-iter-v3

dan (Design): saw the figma — nice work. my first read: compact rows feel busy when badges + metrics stacked. can we try a 2-line compact row (title + micro-metrics) instead of 3? :thinking_face:

oli (Eng): technical FYI — reducing to 2 lines helps render perf for long lists but will break current alignment with the compare-toolbar. we can do it but need a minor refactor to the virtual list cell heights. ETA ~1 day.

jess (Product): question on badges: do we want numerical micro-badges (p95 120ms / $0.03 per 1k) or qualitative chips (fast / medium / slow)? pros/cons?

sam (Research): I recommend numeric + color band. numbers are precise for SREs/PLs, color gives quick scannability. tooltip shows 95th, p50, and cost estimate. example micro-badge mock: [green] "p95 95ms" hover -> "p50 12ms • $0.02 / 1k tokens"

maria (PM): agree with sam. copy tweak: change label from "Pin" to "Pin version for this route" in the overflow so it's clearer. also add keyboard hint: "Press P to pin focused row".

dan (Design): two micro-proposals for pin UX: 1) inline lock icon at the left of version pill with a subtle border when pinned; 2) show a faint horizontal rule at top of pinned rows in compare so pinned versions stick visually. which is less noisy?

oli (Eng): (1) is easiest. we already have version pills as components — adding a small lock SVG and aria attr is trivial. (2) needs row grouping logic in the compare table.

a11y-bot: accessibility note — ensure the pin control is reachable via keyboard and has an explicit aria-pressed and aria-label. example: ```<button aria-label="Pin model version v1.3 to route" aria-pressed="false">🔒</button>``` Also add focus-visible style and >3:1 contrast for the lock icon on hover.

jess (Product): copy nits: current tooltip says "Pin version" — change to "Pin this model version for route (overrides model updates)". also add a small "unpin" confirmation only when pinning a prod route.

maria (PM): filter shelf: folks asked for persistent filters per-user. engineering note: per-route vs per-user persistence? we should default to per-user last-used filters, with an option to save as route preset. thoughts?

sam (Research): per-user default + explicit "Save preset" is the least surprising. we can track last-used filters in local storage and also sync saved presets to user settings. privacy ok? no sensitive data stored.

oli (Eng): ack. local storage fallback + server-synced presets. I'll add an API endpoint to store presets. impl plan: local restore -> query presets -> merge -> show toast if a preset matches.

dan (Design): accessibility nit for compare table headers: we need clearer sort indicators for keyboard/VO users. use "aria-sort=\"ascending\"" and add a sr-only hint: "sorted by latency, press enter to change".

a11y-bot: also recommend increasing the hit target of the sort control to 32px min and include visible focus styles.

maria (PM): action items: dan — push two mocks (2-line compact + 3-line with stacked badges) so we can A/B; oli — estimate rows/virtualization changes + add presets endpoint; jess — update pin tooltip copy and prod confirmation text; sam — write short eval plan to see if numeric badges reduce time-to-decision. Let's sync tomorrow 10am. :calendar:
